item.title: How I use AI in development (Cursor and Claude)
item.description:
The question I hear most about day-to-day AI is not “which model do you use?” It is “how do you organize this so it does not turn into a mess?”

I use AI constantly, in code and on this blog. What changed my routine was not a miracle prompt. It was treating the agent like someone who joins the project with no context: if the rule is not in a file, it does not exist. Skills, AGENTS.md, agents with narrow roles, and me reviewing the result. No magic.

item.title: Claude Code: from PRD to pull request with agents
item.description:
Introduction

I discovered Claude Code a few months ago when our team was struggling to keep code reviews consistent. After six weeks with the tool, we cut average PR time from 4 days to 1 day — and that was only the start.

Claude Code automates a large part of the development workflow. PRDs, TDD, code review, even MCP setup. It is not magic, but it works well enough to change the day-to-day.
